== Possibly faulty data: rarity source ==
The [https://web.archive.org/web/20020611180951/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/index.html archived A New Hope Light Side list] records Sensor Panel as U1. The existing article and its Complete Card List citation give U2. This source-only edit leaves rarity unchanged pending comparison of the two records. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20020613010949/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/small/sensorpanel.html original Decipher card page] now replaces the generic cardlists-index citation; its black-border image matches the article's printed card. Easter egg and combination references are unchanged. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] 20:18, 6 November 2026 (UTC)
